sets.title: Artifact sets
sets.intro: Each dungeon gives a four-piece set for one hero class — other classes can't wear it. Two pieces give the first bonus, four give another. You can mix rarities: a threshold's numbers come from the rarity of the N-th rarest piece, so 2 Unique and 2 Common pieces give the first bonus at Unique and the second at Common.
